name: Deshi Shahi Cow
description: A healthy and strong deshi cow, well-fed with natural grass and grains. Perfect for Qurbani with a clean bill of health. This cow has been raised in a clean environment with proper veterinary care.

name: Friesian Bull
description: A premium Friesian bull with large build and healthy weight. Ideal for large families or group Qurbani. This bull has been raised with high-quality feed and regular health checkups.

name: Shahiwal Premium
description: A beautiful Shahiwal breed cow known for its gentle nature and good meat quality. Raised in Rajshahi with fresh river-side grass and organic feed. Fully vaccinated and certified healthy.

name: Crossbreed Giant
description: A powerful crossbreed combining the best traits of Deshi and Friesian breeds. Large build with excellent meat quality. Raised in the lush green hills of Sylhet with premium care.

name: Black Bengal Goat
description: A classic Black Bengal goat, the pride of Bangladesh. Known for its superior meat quality and moderate size, perfect for small families. Well-fed on natural grass and leaves.

name: Jamuna Pari Goat
description: A large and healthy Jamuna Pari goat with impressive size. This breed is known for its adaptability and good meat yield. Raised with care in Jessore and fully vaccinated.

name: Beetal Goat
description: A premium Beetal goat with excellent body weight and health. This breed is popular for Qurbani due to its good meat quality. Raised naturally in Mymensingh with proper care.

name: Brahman Bull
description: A majestic Brahman bull, the largest in our collection. Perfect for large community Qurbani events. This bull has been specially raised with premium feed and professional veterinary care.
